title: OverlayPanel
lead: OverlayPanel, also known as Popover, is a container component that can overlay other components on page.

examples.name: Basic
prose: OverlayPanel is accessed via its reference and visibility is controlled using toggle, show and hide methods with an event of the target.

examples.name: DataTable
prose: An example that displays a DataTable inside a popup to select an item. closeOnEscape is enabled to close the popop when ESC is pressed. The dismissable property when set to false will not close the popup when the document is clicked outside the popup.
